eligibility.eligibility_rule: Shanghai DT/HT oral aliases retained; DF fecal aliases excluded

protocol: nested leave-one-source-study-out; inner macro-study AUC selects K=30 or 139; SHAP ranking refit on training rows only

training_scope.note: PRJNA782768 and PRJNA910326 are deposited by the same Shanghai publication; all Shanghai source rows excluded. Participant independence is unresolved.

three_cohort_pooled.note: Descriptive pooled benchmark with different source fits; Shanghai source study excluded for related benchmark.

downsample_reconstruction.uncertainty_note: Seed percentiles describe algorithm/subsample variability on the same 50-person benchmark, not a patient confidence interval or independent replications.

limitations: Source-only nesting prevents row leakage but cannot undo prior choice of CatBoost/parameters. Six studies give high-variance macro AUC; this reconstruction is retrospective. A new untouched cohort is required for confirmatory transfer evaluation.
